plugin_description: Change workspace indicator with per-state custom icons, for Hyprland and Niri.

compositor.label: Compositor
compositor.description: Which compositor to query for workspace state. Auto-detects Hyprland or Niri.

workspace_display_mode.label: Workspace visibility
workspace_display_mode.description: Choose which workspace pills to show in the bar.

workspace_count.label: Workspace count
workspace_count.description: How many workspace slots to check (1 to this number).

enable_animation.label: Animate transitions
enable_animation.description: Smoothly ease icon size on focus/state changes instead of snapping instantly.

icon_focused.label: Focused icon
icon_focused.description: Emoji or absolute path to an image/gif for the focused workspace. Animated gifs need ImageMagick installed. Default: 🌕 Full moon.

icon_urgent.label: Urgent icon
icon_urgent.description: Emoji or absolute path to an image/gif for a workspace with urgent activity. Animated gifs need ImageMagick installed. Default: 🌟 Star.

icon_occupied.label: Occupied icon
icon_occupied.description: Emoji or absolute path to an image/gif for an occupied, unfocused workspace. Animated gifs need ImageMagick installed. Default: 🌗 Half moon.

icon_empty.label: Empty icon
icon_empty.description: Emoji or absolute path to an image/gif for an empty workspace. Animated gifs need ImageMagick installed. Default: 🌙 Crescent moon.

size_focused.label: Focused size
size_focused.description: Icon size in pixels for the focused workspace.

size_urgent.label: Urgent size
size_urgent.description: Icon size in pixels for an urgent workspace.

size_occupied.label: Occupied size
size_occupied.description: Icon size in pixels for an occupied workspace.

size_empty.label: Empty size
size_empty.description: Icon size in pixels for an empty workspace.

focused_pill_style.label: Focused pill background
focused_pill_style.description: Show a colored pill behind the focused icon, or make it non-existent (bare icon only).

focused_color.label: Focused pill color
focused_color.description: Fill color behind the focused workspace's icon.

urgent_pill_style.label: Urgent pill background
urgent_pill_style.description: Show a colored pill behind the urgent icon, or make it non-existent (bare icon only).

urgent_color.label: Urgent pill color
urgent_color.description: Fill color behind an urgent workspace's icon.

occupied_pill_style.label: Occupied pill background
occupied_pill_style.description: Show a colored pill behind the occupied icon, or make it non-existent (bare icon only).

occupied_color.label: Occupied pill color
occupied_color.description: Fill color behind an occupied workspace's icon.

empty_pill_style.label: Empty pill background
empty_pill_style.description: Show a colored pill behind the empty icon, or make it non-existent (bare icon only).

empty_color.label: Empty pill color
empty_color.description: Fill color behind an empty workspace's icon.
